answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the dune queue while honest agents promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 199 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the tide. The jade index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 165 account operation therefore ties up 3 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
